meaning: Finite interpretations for the nine derivations of round 4: for each premise other than excluded middle, a hand-written Unit or Bool model, checked by decide without axioms, in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails (33 omission models); and one joint nonvacuity witness in which every premise and conclusion of the batch holds with populated antecedents. Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
